question: How do egoism and anger make sacrifice fruitless?
premises: they resort to egoism strength pride desire and anger
they hate the Lord in self and other bodies
their sacrifices are by name and do not fruit
inference: egoism and anger make sacrifice fruitless and hatred of the Lord
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are kept whole
plain_english: Resorting to egoism, strength, pride, desire, and anger, hating the Lord in self and other bodies, they sacrifice by name; such sacrifices do not fruit, and hating worlds they hate the Lord, who is Vasudeva, the all-dwelling.
